parameters.content:
## Lokalise targets audit - nightly

Weekdays 04:00 Europe/Madrid. Picks the active project (lokalise_project_labels, minus My QR Code html) audited longest ago, audits every translated string in every target language (glossary + style guide, no spelling), files an INTERNAT Task with the workbook and posts to #i18n-team: summary on top, languages + Jira link in thread.

**Change rules** in data table targets_audit_style_rules (one row per language, iso * = generic rules). **Rotation state** in data table targets_audit_rotation — delete a row to re-audit a project sooner. Each language runs in the worker sub-workflow ME3cLqQy0Dlzm6si.
